newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Nikkei futures end firm ahead elections.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Nikkei futures end firm ahead elections.

text.p: SIMEX Nikkei futures ended on a buoyant note on Friday, following the Dow's overnight surge to a new record close and growing optimism about the outcome of the Japanese general election this weekend.
"Everybody's expecting the LDP (Liberal Democratic Party) to win and they've bought in anticipation of it," said a dealer with a Japanese institution.
After hitting a high of 21,845, the benchmark Nikkei 225 December contract finished at 21,715 against a previous settlement at 21,485. Volume was a healthy 24,845 lots.
The trader said an LDP victory might prompt some late bulls to push the market higher early next week, but he added that the December Nikkei would then be vulnerable to profit-taking.
"The market's been going up very fast. I believe we'll see a retracement soon," he said.
Dealers said the index should be supported at 21,600 and at the more solid level of 21,400, with initial resistance at 22,000.
